automatedDeepRedTeam.importantFindingClassification: The deep red-team sequence found and closed defense-in-depth and recoverability defects without changing field classifications or the canvass opener. The destructive-import issue could erase local device-training history but could not manufacture readiness or official certification authority.
automatedDeepRedTeam.transferTrustBoundary: Manual/local progress JSON is not a cryptographically trusted certification credential. Device progress may be edited by a device owner; official certification therefore remains separate and requires current Paradise human/field authority.

Validation passed; upgrade those actions when an appropriate supported major is available.
